summary: Virgin Galactic Holdings filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market program of up to $250,000,000 of common stock under an Open Market Sale Agreement with Jefferies LLC dated November 12, 2026. Jefferies acts as agent or principal at a commission of up to 3.0% of gross sales; shares trade on the NYSE under SPCE, last sale $2.87 on November 11, 2026. Proceeds fund working capital, a new high-cadence launch hangar, rocket production expansion, and partial repayment of 9.80% First Lien Notes due 2028, with at least 35% of net proceeds required to redeem notes under the indenture. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; the risk-arb angle centers on dilution pace and mandatory debt redemption.
